summary: Lake Shore Bancorp filed an 8-K reporting that its Board declared a $0.09 per share cash dividend on common stock, payable August 12, 2026 to holders of record August 3, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, or other corporate event is involved. The filing solely satisfies disclosure obligations for a regular dividend and is accompanied by a press release.
